تلتحقن (form VIII)
# تَلْتَحِقْنَ (taltaḥiqna) /tal.ta.ħiq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
# تُلْتَحَقْنَ (tultaḥaqna) /tul.ta.ħaq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِلْتَحَقَ (iltaḥaqa)
